media.title: The Potter's Wheel
media.content:
The Potter's Wheel

Old Uncle George was famous for making the strongest clay pots in the sub-county. He dug fine red clay from the valley and mixed it with water until it was smooth. Sitting under a shaded mango tree, he spun his wooden wheel and shaped the clay with gentle fingers. Children sat in a circle around him, watching grey lumps turn into beautiful water jars and cooking bowls. Uncle George smiled and told them that patience and a soft touch could shape anything in life.

questions.text: What material does Uncle George use to make pots?
options: Fine red clay from the valley
White sand from the lake shore
questions.answer: Fine red clay from the valley
